A food item which restores {{Energy|+|50}} and applies the hard worker buff when consumed. Since the items which can be used to craft {{lc:{{PAGENAME}}}} lack quality levels they can not be improved by using higher quality ingredients. For more information on preparing food see [[cooking]]. 

==Effect==

On use, Pasta will apply the hard worker buff for a duration of 2 minutes reducing the amount of energy spent mining and woodcutting by 49%. For a list of all buffs see the [[Effects]] page.
